messages:
amy-sales: Heads-up — NimbusHealth POC is hitting intermittent 429s during stress runs. Demo tomorrow morning; they send ~40 concurrent completion requests and see a bunch of 429s.
jeff-support: Can you paste one of the raw 429 responses and the route they're hitting?
aj-sales: paste below from their logs (redacted):
```json
{"error":"rate_limit_exceeded","message":"Quota exceeded","route":"/v1/completions","quota_type":"burst_per_route","retry_after":12,"request_id":"abc123"}
```
aj-eng: Looks like a per-route burst cap firing (`burst_per_route`). Their trial tenant has a conservative per-route burst (500/min) while their client runs lots of short-lived concurrent streams. Two immediate options: 1) temporarily raise the per-route burst for the POC tenant, or 2) recommend client lower concurrency + implement exponential backoff with Retry-After and jitter.
samir-oncall: I can bump the per-route burst to 2k for 24h if we want to avoid the demo outage. Need approval from @amy-sales to proceed.
amy-sales: Please do the bump. They'll be running the demo at 10:00 PST. Also quick Q — are embeddings counted against the same token budget or separate caps? They ran embeddings concurrently too.
aj-eng: Embeddings and completions consume the tenant token budget (same pool) but per-route burst caps are independent. So you can get 429s on completions even if monthly token usage is low. Worth checking their monthly token usage as well.
jeff-support: I pulled their usage: monthly token commit at 12% used, so not a tenant budget exhaust issue.
samir-oncall: Bumping now. deploy-bot: Quota change request queued (ID 9876).
deploy-bot: Change applied — per-route burst for /v1/completions set to 2000 for tenant `nimbus-health` until 1843300000 (24h). Monitor for next 10m.
amy-sales: Running their stress test again... so far no 429s, looks stable :thumbsup:
aj-eng: For client guidance, send them this snippet — keep max_concurrency ~8, honor Retry-After header and backoff with jitter. Example: `max_concurrency=8; on_429: sleep = min(60, base * 2**attempt) + jitter; use Retry-After when provided.`
amy-sales: Sending guidance to NimbusHealth now and letting them know the temporary bump. Will follow up if anything else pops up. Thanks everyone! :heart:
